summary: Dependency resolved from off-registry HTTP URL, enabling arbitrary install-time code execution
details: package.json line 12 declares the package's sole dependency as a bare URL rather than a registry version range: `linker-client-string-async` is sourced from https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever tarball bytes that host returns and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in them, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no registry provenance. The host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage and its contents are mutable, so the delivered code can change at any time without a new publish of this package. The shipped source is a one-line stub that re-exports that dependency, so the manifest line is effectively the entire published surface; the absence of lifecycle scripts in this package does not prevent the fetch or the execution of scripts inside the fetched artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
